name: StarDrift Delivery
description:
About This Game

Welcome to the gig economy across the galaxies. You are unfortunately in huge debt to the mob and must smuggle your way out of it.

THE DEBT ECONOMY

In this economy, you get your base commission, but that won't make up for your debt.

  • COMMISSION: The base pay for a delivery. Safe, reliable, but will never be enough for survival.

  • THE BONUS: The multiplier on your commission. Grazing asteroids, attacking the space cops, any risky action will add to it.

THE GAMEPLAY

  • THE ACTION: You don't just dodge asteroids. Blast through them to turn destruction into speed literally.

  • THE TIMER: The clock is always ticking. Fail to pay off an installment on time, and the mob will get you.

  • DYNAMIC JOBS: Accept safe, low-paying deliveries or go all out with dangerous smuggling operations where the space cops will hunt you down.

FEATURES AND PROGRESSION

  • SECTORS: 4 sectors to beat with each having different mechanics and fresh visuals.

  • UPGRADES: Pay off an installment and the mob will grant you a contract/upgrade. Stack upgrades together to fundamentally change how you fly. 

  • LOADOUTS: Features 4 hoverboards each with different playstyles. Switch from a speedy, electric board to a heavy, hard-hitting one.

  • LEADERBOARDS: Compete globally and with friends to be the fastest across the sectors.

The clock is running. The boss is waiting.
Pay up or get scrapped.
short_desc: Smuggle your way to freedom in this fast-paced space delivery action roguelite where you are in debt to the mob. Blast through asteroids for speed, weave through chaos, and deliver packages to survive. Don't let the debt consume you.
